::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## <i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i>&nbsp; About this catalog
This proof-of-concept catalog contains **9 sample datasets** spread across
demographics, health, education, labour, agriculture, poverty, gender, and
migration. Metadata is realistic and Tanzania-relevant, but downloadable files
are small **placeholder CSVs** — not real or real-looking microdata. Use the
search box, category chips, and sort control below to explore.
:::
